findings.text: follow-on: the localization is demonstrated on a reconstructed banked terminal state with the level row residual exactly 0.0, not on a live production Krylov pass; the working H200 receipt (job 1280166, revision 8289cdb9) predates the active_set_* history arrays and retains only the final frozen-mask pass, so the first failing active-set pass cannot be numbered and the done-worthy every-pass table is unproduced. The worker disclosed this honestly and the coordinator reassigned the fresh receipt to a separate repair node; it is recorded here so the coordinator does not read the node's status: complete as claiming the every-pass deliverable.

follow-on: edf04ca11 is an unmerged local-only commit: it is reachable from the reviewed worktree HEAD but is NOT an ancestor of the review base b12cb22cc, so the localization is not yet durable on the primary branch and the fix it localises cannot yet be landed against it. Landing edf04ca11 is the coordinator's step and must precede or accompany the cap-factor repair node.

justifications.durability: The single commit edf04ca11 carries a conventional subject and a substantive body, no attribution trailer and no plan, sprint or ticket label, and the reviewed worktree is clean at that tip. The deduction is reachability: edf04ca11 is an ancestor of the reviewed worktree's own HEAD but is NOT an ancestor of my base b12cb22cc, so the commit is an unmerged local-only deliverable and the localization is not yet durable on the primary branch. That is the coordinator's landing step rather than a worker defect, but a reviewer reading main cannot reach it today, and the report itself lives outside the repository and so is not versioned with the commit it describes.
justifications.evidence: Every load-bearing number reproduces first-hand at the reviewed revision. I reran the committed gate (JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu, shared interpreter run directly, module benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py from the reviewed worktree) and got EXIT=0 with the identical receipt: source_state_sha256_binary64 f1097ebdb78a38860580e589c878105a1ba7832ac87bcf63f6ce30a51efdbfbd, jvp [1,-1,null], central_difference [0.9999999999997856,-1.0,0.10000000001397778]. The mechanism is exactly characterised and I verified the arithmetic independently: 1/tiny**2 = inf for float64, and the zero tangent of maximum(|raw|,tiny) times that inf gives inf*0 = NaN; the derivative of the original factor at raw=0 is NaN while the primal is 1.0. The proposed repair step_limit/maximum(step_limit,abs(raw)) is algebraically equivalent away from zero and I confirmed by an independent reproduction that its level JVP becomes [1,-1,0.1], finite and matching the central difference. I also confirmed the claim that the defect is not direction-specific: with an all-zero tangent direction the level output is still NaN. The slot-0 claim is verified in code (fixed_point.py:2212 sets phase PROBE first; :2271 probe_slot records probe_action; :2712 finite_linear_action over probe_action; :2768 assigns NONFINITE_LINEAR_ACTION), so the non-finite operand is read at the pre-Arnoldi probe before any basis is built. The one deduction is that the evidence is demonstrated on a reconstructed banked state rather than a live production pass, and the every-pass table the done-when asked for is absent (honestly, not deceptively).
justifications.fit: The work follows house convention: instrumentation is confined to the benchmark driver (the permitted location), the diagnostic reads the banked receipt through the operator's own damped_step rather than reimplementing it, the solver path is untouched, comments are mechanism-worded with no plan or ticket labels, and the report is structured report-first with the outcome line corrected from NEEDS-HELP as the resume ruling asked. The proposed repair preserves the existing step cap, field bound, tolerance and solver defaults and is stated with a two-part confirming measurement. It loses a small amount for citing the receipt as the published docs/figures copy without noting it verified the digest against the run-dir copy (I checked: they are byte-identical), and for a report table that names a row 'ordinal unavailable' where the done-when asked for the first failing pass.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node's goal -- localise the non-finite Krylov linear action that stopped the unit-leverage centroid-constrained solve -- is met and independently reproduced: at the banked terminal state digest f1097ebdb78a38860580e589c878105a1ba7832ac87bcf63f6ce30a51efdbfbd (which matches the source receipt byte-for-byte, published and run-dir copies identical at sha256 f281f0de...f3) I reran the committed diagnostic first-hand and got jvp [1,-1,NaN], central difference [1,-1,0.100000000014], field_block_finite True, level_block_finite False; the operand is pinned to the level step-rule cap derivative at an exactly zero level residual (level_row_scaled_residual 0.0), and I confirmed the proposed algebraic repair makes the level JVP finite and equal to the central difference. The gap against the literal done-when is the headline every-pass H200 receipt and its per-pass table: the banked H200 job 1280166 predates the active_set_* history fields and retained only the final frozen-mask pass, so the first failing pass cannot be numbered; the worker disclosed this rather than fabricating rows, and the coordinator's resume ruling accepted the localization and moved the fresh receipt to a separate repair node, but on the dispatch's own measure the GPU receipt is unproduced.
justifications.scope_discipline: The change is minimal and inside scope: one commit edf04ca11 adds exactly 50 lines to the single declared path benchmarks/centroid_constrained_fixture_receipt.py, plus the report at its declared out-of-repo path .../crew/reports/nova/s22/cco-nonfinite-krylov-action.md. The declared figure and evidence-fragment paths were correctly left unwritten -- the prompt states the done-when names no artifact so the node writes no figure and no evidence prose -- and no tolerance or solver default was touched. No peer path was modified.
